**Changelog for fulcra-tracking v0.0.3**

- Updated workflow to support both Standalone and Project/Team modes, clarifying when to skip discovery and quick visibility steps.
- Replaced the full dashboard demo generation with an optional quick HTML preview, focusing on lightweight, single-file previews for fast feedback.
- Removed references and workflow dependencies on demonstration, discovery, and record-annotations markdown files.
- Updated guidance to direct users to the `fulcra-dashboard` skill for full-featured dashboards and to `fulcra-agent-teams` for team-based data tracking.
- Simplified workflow descriptions for improved clarity and flexibility.

- Updated instructions to refer to the new full skill path fulcradynamics/agent-skills/fulcra-dashboard for dashboard handoff.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file for better project organization.
- Documentation and references refined for improved clarity and workflow guidance.

Initial release of fulcra-tracking skill.

- Enables users to record custom data annotations and agent visibility metrics in Fulcra.
- Guides users from intent discovery through schema setup, data entry, and HTML dashboard generation.
- Auto-generates simple, static HTML dashboards (using Alpine.js/D3.js/CSS) for visualizing tracked data.
- Includes support and onboarding for the Universal Agent Visibility Package.
- Prompts users to upgrade to a live, interactive React-based dashboard with the fulcra-dashboard skill.
